```{r}
# Function to calculate GARCH volatility and VaR
calculate_garch_var_daily <- function(returns, omega, alpha, beta, confidence_level) {
  n <- length(returns)
  garch_volatility_1<- numeric(n)
  var_garch_1 <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 2:n) {
    garch_volatility_1[i] <- sqrt(omega + alpha * returns[i-1]^2 + beta * garch_volatility_1[i-1]^2)
    
    # Assuming a normal distribution for simplicity
    z_score <- qnorm(1 - (1 - confidence_level) / 2)
    var_garch_1[i] <- garch_volatility_1[i] * z_score
  }
  
  return(list(volatility = garch_volatility_1, VaR = var_garch_1))
}

# Set parameters
omega_GARCH <- 0.0001
alpha_GARCH <- 0.1
beta_GARCH <- 0.8
confidence_level <- 0.95

# Calculate GARCH volatility and VaR for the portfolio
garch_results <- calculate_garch_var_daily(portfolio_returns, omega_GARCH, alpha_GARCH, beta_GARCH, confidence_level)

# Print results (for example, printing the first 10 values)
cat("Portfolio GARCH Volatility:\n", head(garch_results$volatility, 10), "\n")
cat("Portfolio GARCH VaR:\n", head(garch_results$VaR*initial_asset_value, 10), "\n")


# Function to calculate EWMA volatility and VaR
calculate_ewma_var_daily <- function(returns, lambda, confidence_level) {
  n <- length(returns)
  ewma_volatility <- numeric(n)
  var_ewma <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 2:n) {
    ewma_volatility[i] <- sqrt(EMA(returns[i]^2, n = 1, alpha = lambda, wilder = FALSE))
    
    # Assuming a normal distribution for simplicity
    z_score <- qnorm(1 - (1 - confidence_level) / 2)
    var_ewma[i] <- ewma_volatility[i] * z_score
  }
  
  return(list(volatility = ewma_volatility, VaR = var_ewma))
}

# Set parameters
lambda_EWMA <- 0.94

# Calculate EWMA volatility and VaR for the portfolio
ewma_results <- calculate_ewma_var_daily(portfolio_returns, lambda_EWMA, confidence_level)

# Print results (for example, printing the first 10 values)
cat("Portfolio EWMA Volatility:\n", head(ewma_results$volatility, 10), "\n")
cat("Portfolio EWMA VaR:\n", head(ewma_results$VaR*initial_asset_value, 10), "\n")

```
```{r}
# Function to calculate SMA volatility and VaR
calculate_sma_var_daily <- function(returns, window_size, confidence_level) {
  n <- length(returns)
  sma_volatility <- numeric(n)
  var_sma <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in window_size:n) {
    sma_volatility[i] <- sd(returns[(i - window_size + 1):i])
    
    # Assuming a normal distribution for simplicity
    z_score <- qnorm(1 - (1 - confidence_level) / 2)
    var_sma[i] <- sma_volatility[i] * z_score
  }
  
  return(list(volatility = sma_volatility, VaR = var_sma))
}

# Set parameters
sma_window_size <- 10

# Calculate SMA volatility and VaR for the portfolio
sma_results <- calculate_sma_var_daily(portfolio_returns, sma_window_size, confidence_level)

# Print results (for example, printing the first 10 values)
cat("Portfolio SMA Volatility:\n", head(sma_results$volatility, 10), "\n")
cat("Portfolio SMA VaR:\n", head(sma_results$VaR*initial_asset_value, 10), "\n")

```

```{r}
library(timeSeries)
# Assuming portfolio_returns is a time series with a 'Date' index
portfolio_retu <- as.timeSeries(project_Data$portfolio_returns)

# Extract returns from the time series
returns <- as.numeric(coredata(portfolio_retu))

# Calculate actual volatility using rolling standard deviation
actual_volatility <- rollapply(returns, width = 10, FUN = sd, align = "right", fill = NA)

# Remove NAs introduced by the rolling standard deviation calculation
actual_volatility <- actual_volatility[complete.cases(actual_volatility)]

# Calculate RMSE for each model
rmse_garch <- sqrt(mean((garch_results$volatility - actual_volatility)^2))
rmse_ewma <- sqrt(mean((ewma_results$volatility - actual_volatility)^2))
rmse_sma <- sqrt(mean((sma_results$volatility - actual_volatility)^2))

# Print RMSE values
cat("RMSE for GARCH model:", rmse_garch, "\n")
cat("RMSE for EWMA model:", rmse_ewma, "\n")
cat("RMSE for SMA model:", rmse_sma, "\n")
```
